visual.reason: 用户明确请求冒险漫画，故事以喊声、回声、卷刺和倒退构成可见先后因果，四格折页是交给用户并收藏的视觉物件。前篇没有独立载体，漫画也区别于此前明信片、照片和物件图。

carrier.purpose: 让用户看到宠物独立冒险中从试探到卷刺再倒退的完整因果，而非仅展示特殊形态结果。
carrier.viewpoint: 宠物回家后画给用户的冒险漫画；每格用第三方漫画视角呈现动作，用户看展开的折页。
carrier.form: 1:1方形展开奶油色纸折页，2×2四格，细深色格框、清楚宽格间距，按左上→右上→左下→右下阅读；完整纸边，外侧朴素中性色背景。五个气泡使用简体中文，无标题或其他文字。
mustShow: 恰好2×2四格，纸边和分格可辨，顺序为左上到右上再左下到右下
第1格：戴浅黄低圆叶帽的普通成年刺猬朝洞内喊，单气泡喂？
第2格：普通背刺延续，只探入一小步，洞深卷风靠近背部，两个来自洞内的回声气泡各为喂？
第3格：同一身体背刺变成恰好三团大圆螺旋，奶白短吻和四短肉足不变，单气泡咦！
第4格：同一三团卷刺身体朝洞内、头回望洞外的路，倒退至洞口，单气泡先退一步。
四格浅黄小圆叶帽和露出的圆耳连续；普通背刺到三团卷刺的变化可辨
没有用户本人或真实公园/博物馆场景，没有其他文字

visuals.description: 四格冒险漫画折页：喊声→双回声与卷风→三团卷刺→倒退到洞口，帽子贯穿。
visuals.request:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a pet's four-panel comic leaflet given to the user.
Primary request: Draw exactly FOUR clearly separated comic panels in a square 1:1 unfolded cream-paper leaflet, a 2×2 grid with wide clear gutters and fine dark panel borders. Read left to right across the top row, then left to right across the bottom row. No title or extra panels. Each panel has one large clear action and a readable Simplified Chinese speech bubble. Keep the same cute compact pixel-art adult warm-brown hedgehog body, cream muzzle and belly, dark glossy eyes, round ears and four short fleshy feet throughout; the same pale-yellow low round leaf hat, narrow brim and simple grass-fibre band stays on its head in ALL FOUR PANELS, both ears exposed.
Panel 1, TOP LEFT: outside a small dark cave in a grassy slope, the NORMAL adult hedgehog with blunt soft spine clusters stands facing the cave mouth and calls inside. ONE speech bubble from the hedgehog with EXACT text 喂？
Panel 2, TOP RIGHT: same NORMAL hedgehog takes only one small step into the cave; a plainly visible curling gust rises from the dark cave depths toward its back. TWO distinct echo speech bubbles come FROM DEEP INSIDE THE CAVE, each with EXACT text 喂？ and 喂？. Its back is still the ordinary uncurled spine clusters in this panel.
Panel 3, BOTTOM LEFT: the gust has turned its back spines into EXACTLY THREE LARGE ROUND SPIRAL TUFTS, attached to the same living body. The cream muzzle and all four short feet are still visible, hat stays the same. Show a surprised reaction and one bubble with EXACT text 咦！
Panel 4, BOTTOM RIGHT: the SAME THREE-SPIRAL hedgehog backs OUT through the cave entrance; its BODY FACES TOWARD THE CAVE INTERIOR while its head turns backward to look at the path outside. It retreats feet-first/backward rather than walking toward the cave. Keep three spiral tufts and hat visible. ONE bubble from the pet with EXACT text 先退一步。
Art: cute cartoon pixel comic with crisp blocky colour shapes, sparse backgrounds, warm brown and cream pet, pale-yellow hat, moss-green grass and dark-earth cave. Make the regular-to-three-spiral transformation clear and retain the same identity. Simplified Chinese bubble text must be large, clean, exact, with punctuation as written. The only image text is these five bubble utterances; no numerals, arrows, labels, captions or other writing. Physical leaflet alone on plain neutral backing, complete paper edges visible, opaque. Input image 1 is the accepted ordinary-hatted hedgehog identity for panels 1 and 2. Input image 2 is the accepted same pet with three spiral tufts for panels 3 and 4. Match its THREE large upright spiral tufts along the back, integrated into the same hedgehog body, with the same cream-tipped curled layers and brown palette. Use both images only as character identities, not as panel backgrounds.
